title: Hexenverhoerprotokolle (SiGS corpus, LAUDATIO repository)
notes: The SiGS corpus published in LAUDATIO (DOI resolves live 200) contains 18 Early New High German witch-trial interrogation protocols 1570–1665 (Jever, Alme, Bamberg, München, Wernigerode, Osnabrück, Crivitz, Helmstedt, Leonberg, Memmingen...), matching the harvest origins 'Hexenverhörprotokoll Wernigerode1597' etc. one-for-one. Texts derive from Macha et al. (2005) 'Deutsche Kanzleisprache in Hexenverhörprotokollen der Frühen Neuzeit', converted to TEI P5 and further encoded as PAULA XML/relANNIS for ANNIS — hence encoding 'other' (PAULA, TEI-derived). Project page with corpus map: uni-muenster.de/SIGS-Projekt/corpus/index.html (200). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: DFG project SiGS / Universities of Muenster, Cologne and Hamburg (Renata Szczepaniak, Klaus-Michael Koepcke, Fabian Barteld, Stefan Hartmann et al.); published in LAUDATIO (HU Berlin)
